newsitem.title: USA: Callon adds offshore natgas production.
newsitem.headline: Callon adds offshore natgas production.

text.p: Callon Petroleum Co said two wells in federal waters offshore Louisiana have been completed as natural gas producers.

At Main Pass Block 165, the company's #A-3 well was recompleted as a dual producer, it said. Production from both zones is about 6.3 million cubic feet of natural gas per day. Callon owns a 67 percent working interest in the block.

At Chandeleur Block 41, the #2A well was drilled to a total measured depth of 6,246 feet. The objective 3,800-foot sand encountered eight feet of net gas pay and is producing 1.4 million cubic feet daily. Callon owns a 100 percent working interest in the block.
